description: This file defines the interface for the IXCast component in the WPEFramework, including enums, structs, and virtual methods for managing cast applications, device info, and notifications.

classes.name: IXCast
classes.description: Interface for cast service operations, including application management, device info, and notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for cast events.

methods.name: SetApplicationState
methods.description: Sets the state of a specified application.

methods.name: GetProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the supported DIAL protocol version.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the cast service.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the cast service is enabled.

methods.name: SetStandbyBehavior
methods.description: Sets the standby behavior of the device.

methods.name: RegisterApplications
methods.description: Registers applications with the cast service.

methods.name: UnregisterApplications
methods.description: Unregisters applications from the cast service.
